description: This file defines an interface and a concrete implementation for a notes repository that manages loading and saving notes using shared preferences storage.

classes.name: INotesRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface defining methods for loading and saving notes.

classes.name: SharedPrefsNotesRepository
classes.description: A concrete implementation of INotesRepository using shared_preferences for persistence, storing notes as JSON.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads all notes from shared preferences storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the list of notes to shared preferences storage.
